title: Stamptime stamp
description: Everything the Stamptime page needs to render one Swarm postage stamp. Returned by GET /api/v1/stamps/{batchId}. Examples in public/examples/. The only token amount is pricing.bzzPerDay, which the page shows in the Add time sheet next to its dollar equivalent; nowhere else shows BZZ or PLUR.

batchId.description: The postage batch id, 64 lower case hex characters, no 0x prefix.

status.description: active: the batch has balance left. expired: a BatchCreated exists for this id, but the balance is zero or the batch was removed from contract state. not_found: no BatchCreated was ever emitted for this id on the current PostageStamp contract. 'Expiring soon' is a page rule (14 days or less), not a status.

chain.description: Where and when the live values were read.

contract.description: PostageStamp contract address the data was read from.

rpc.description: Host of the RPC used, shown in the footer for transparency. Host only, no keys.

block.description: Block number at which remainingBalance and the price were read.

blockTime.description: Timestamp of that block, ISO 8601 UTC. The page uses it as 'now' for the bar and the days left.

owner.description: Batch owner, from BatchCreated (or batches(id) while the batch is in state). Checksummed.

depth.description: Current batch depth, after any BatchDepthIncrease.

capacity.description: Usable capacity for this depth and immutability, as a human label, for example '7.7 GB'. Take it from the effective volume table in the Swarm docs. Do not compute 2^depth x 4 KB: that is the theoretical maximum and overstates what fits.

time.description: active: most likely end, blockTime + (remainingBalance / currentPrice) x 5 s. expired: when the balance ran out, or null if it cannot be reconstructed.

earliest.description: active: end if the price rose to the highest price of the last 30 days. null when expired.

latest.description: active: end if the price fell to the lowest price of the last 30 days. null when expired.

lastBlock.description: expired: the block at which the balance ran out, if known. null when active.

bzzPerDay.description: What one more day of this whole stamp costs today, in BZZ: currentPrice x 2^depth x 17280 blocks / 1e16. Comes from the chain alone, no exchange rate. Shown only in the Add time sheet, next to the dollar equivalent. null when expired.

usdPerDay.description: What one more day of this whole stamp costs today, in USD: bzzPerDay x BZZ/USD. null if no USD rate is available; the page then hides dollar figures. Drives the 'from about $' line, the keepers' dollars and the equivalent under each BZZ amount in the Add time sheet.

contributions.description: One entry per on chain event that paid for time: the BatchCreated, then every BatchTopUp, oldest first. The page groups them by address into the Keepers ranking.

address.description: Who paid: the from address of the transaction that emitted the event. BatchTopUp carries no payer, so read it from the transaction.

days.description: Days of storage this payment bought for the whole stamp, at the price in force at that block and the depth at that block: (amount / 2^depth) / price x 5 s / 86400. Fractions allowed; the page rounds.

usd.description: USD value of the payment at the time, or null if unknown.
